submission.implementation_notes: Fully-applied (data) -> unit validator compiled with Pebble 0.5.0 default settings (source: examples/uplc-cape/src/two-party-escrow.pebble). Deposit/Accept/Refund dispatch on the raw integer redeemer; each endpoint validates payment sums and the no-remaining-script-output rule in a single pass over the outputs, comparing signatures and credentials as raw bytes and reading lovelace through the compiler's raw-value-map amountOf fast path (no unValueData). Uses UPLC 1.2 case/constr (builtin casing) and requires protocol version 11 (van Rossem), live on mainnet since 2026-07-18.
